title: Olomouc — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Olomouc: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Olomouc has a population of 100,000. A historic Moravian university city with a UNESCO-listed Holy Trinity Column, beautiful baroque architecture, and a lively student atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 90 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
